Name: Roku - Yerba Mate
Author: rokuL4D2
Description:
The "mate" is a popular drink in South America and now we can have our own plantation in Stardew Valley :D

This mod contains the mate as a craftable item and it gives you +1 Farming, +10 MaxStamina, and +1 Speed (duration: 180 seconds).

You can buy mate at Pierre's, its seeds and the recipe to make it by yourself.

Yerba Mate plant takes 7 days to mature and you can havest its leaves every two days. Only for spring, summer, fall and interiors.

-Thanks to my girlfriend who helped me designing the assets ♥
